reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 the compiler must provide the four insertion kinds (simple ',' 'B' '0' '/'; special '.'; fixed cs '+' '-' 'CR' 'DB'; floating cs '+' '-') and both zero-suppression-and-replacement kinds ('Z' with spaces, '*' with asterisks) as the editing methods of a PICTURE, rendering each per GR4-GR8 in numeric-edited items and simple insertion in alphanumeric-edited items.

edition-consulted.switches: dialectLevel < 2002: a non-floating currency symbol takes only the CurrencyLeading role (the 1985 chart has one fixed cs row/column); also appends the 1985 chart clause to the COBOL1935 message
edition.DialectLevel < 2002 selects the 1985 BLANK WHEN ZERO arm (asterisk only, VI.5.9.3 SR7) over the 2002+ S-or-asterisk arm; message text
MaxStringLength(edition.DialectLevel) via ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable; CurrencySymbolEquivalence.Fold(currency, DialectLevel); BLANK WHEN ZERO signed-item arm (DialectLevel < 2002)
FoldPictureCase / RepeatableSymbol by dialectLevel (which symbols take a repetition factor at 1985)

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'DialectLevel|CobolVersion|Edition|Std' over CobolEdit*.cs: none (the runtime editor is edition-blind); grep DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry over PictureAnalyzer.cs and PictureComposition.cs gives the sites listed. None of them switches which editing kinds exist or how they render.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the editing kinds and their rendering are edition-blind; the 1985 arms on the path (fixed cs leading-only, BLANK WHEN ZERO, string length) belong to other rules (GR6, VI.5.9.3 SR7, the length bound).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb490 exercises simple insertion (/, 0, B, ',') with Z, * and floating strings; not exercised there: special '.', fixed CR/DB/-, floating '-', all-positions floating or suppression with a zero value, alphanumeric-edited simple insertion, the largest (18-digit) value

probes.expected: GR4-GR8 at 1985: each kind inserts at its position; fixed sign table (+ gives +/-, - gives space/-, CR/DB two spaces when positive); all-positions floating or Z with a zero value is all spaces, '*' with zero keeps the decimal point; nonzero all-positions floating places the symbol before the point; alphanumeric-edited inserts B 0 /
fixed insertion combines with suppression and with floating cs; signs per the GR6/GR7 tables
